name: fleet-cap
what: A session never has more subagents running at once than the cap for their tier, and finished or stale subagents free their slots.

faults.fault: The cap is off by one, so one extra subagent gets through.
Entries never expire, so a crashed agent locks the session out for good.
SubagentStop always frees the oldest entry and ignores the subagent type.
All sessions share one state file, so their counts mix.
